evidence.panel: LANDINTEL · GOVERNED TERRAIN INTELLIGENCE ROADMAP Terrain decisions must retain their survey evidence LandIntel will connect point clouds and terrain models to project boundaries, design levels and traceable decisions. Visual relief alone is not a result: source, reference system, accuracy, resolution and gaps must remain visible. DATASET STATUS NO TERRAIN SOURCE CONNECTED No terrain surface, anomaly, level, volume or suitability conclusion is asserted. SOURCE MISSING UNKNOWN INDICATIVE SURVEY-VALIDATED ANALYSIS 01 ROADMAP Bare-earth DTM & surface DSM Separate classified ground from buildings, vegetation and other surface returns. Evidence required: Classified point cloud or authority terrain model with documented derivation. ANALYSIS 02 ROADMAP Slope & elevation analysis Screen gradients, elevation ranges and abrupt terrain changes inside the project boundary. Evidence required: Terrain elevations with horizontal and vertical reference systems and stated accuracy. ANALYSIS 03 ROADMAP Drainage paths & low points Identify preliminary flow paths, sinks and low areas for drainage review. Evidence required: Hydrologically conditioned terrain model plus rainfall and drainage context. ANALYSIS 04 ROADMAP Access-gradient screening Compare preliminary road or ramp alignments against target gradients. Evidence required: Terrain surface, proposed alignment, design criteria and verified tie-in levels. ANALYSIS 05 ROADMAP Cut-and-fill estimation Compare existing terrain with a proposed formation surface to estimate earthwork. Evidence required: Surveyed existing surface, design surface, boundary, method and tolerances. ANALYSIS 06 ROADMAP Canopy & obstruction mapping Expose above-ground obstructions and canopy that may affect access or development. Evidence required: Classified above-ground returns with acquisition date and completeness statement. ANALYSIS 07 ROADMAP Building & road cross-sections Inspect the terrain profile along a proposed building, road or user-defined line. Evidence required: Georeferenced terrain plus the current design alignment or footprint revision. ANALYSIS 08 ROADMAP Survey & design-level comparison Measure deviations between terrain evidence, project survey and design levels. Evidence required: Versioned survey and design surfaces in compatible horizontal and vertical datums. EVIDENCE RECORD Capture date Not connected SOURCE MISSING Provider Not connected SOURCE MISSING Resolution / point density UNKNOWN UNKNOWN Classification UNKNOWN UNKNOWN Horizontal CRS UNKNOWN UNKNOWN Vertical datum UNKNOWN UNKNOWN Horizontal / vertical accuracy UNKNOWN UNKNOWN Coverage gaps UNKNOWN UNKNOWN GOVERNED PROCESSING PATH 01Connect terrain source 02Validate provenance & reference systems 03Classify and derive DTM / DSM 04Stream governed 3D terrain 05Run bounded terrain analysis 06Compare survey & design levels 07Record an evidence-linked decision LIDAR DOES NOT ESTABLISH Soil bearing capacity or geotechnical suitability Buried utilities or underground obstructions Foundation type or structural adequacy Legal parcel boundaries, title or ownership INDICATIVE UNTIL VALIDATED AGAINST A PROJECT SURVEY. The module specification is visible; ingestion, terrain processing, 3D visualization and engineering calculations are not yet connected.

evidence.activeTheme: Lawful road access and connectivity checks, plus a configurable proximity catchment — never a fabricated travel time or nearby place. LANDINTEL · ACCESS & CONNECTIVITY ROADMAP Access must be legal, not just adjacent Road frontage, right of way, transit proximity and utility connectivity each need their own verified source. Map-visible adjacency to a road is never treated as proof of lawful access. DATASET STATUS NO ACCESS SOURCE CONNECTED No frontage, right-of-way, transit or utility conclusion is asserted. SOURCE-VERIFIED INDICATIVE INFERRED UNKNOWN STALE CHECK 01 ROADMAP Legal / lawful access Confirm the parcel has a recorded right of way or frontage on a public road, not merely map-visible adjacency. Evidence required: Recorded easement, right-of-way deed, or authority road-frontage record. CHECK 02 ROADMAP Road classification & width Compare the fronting road class and carriageway width against the setback/FAR rules that depend on it. Evidence required: Authority road-width register or a surveyed carriageway measurement. CHECK 03 ROADMAP Public-transit proximity Screen straight-line and network proximity to metro, rail and organized bus stops. Evidence required: Official transit-stop registry with coordinates and a routed (not straight-line) distance/time source. CHECK 04 ROADMAP Utility connectivity Establish whether power, water and sewer connections are available at the boundary versus requiring extension. Evidence required: Utility-provider connection record or a site connectivity certificate. CHECK 05 ROADMAP Arterial / corridor connectivity Assess drive-time reach to arterial roads, ring roads and planned corridors that affect long-run accessibility. Evidence required: Routed drive-time analysis against a maintained road network, not a straight-line radius. EVIDENCE RECORD Frontage / right-of-way record Not connected UNKNOWN Road-width register Not connected UNKNOWN Transit-stop registry UNKNOWN UNKNOWN Utility connection record UNKNOWN UNKNOWN Routed drive-time engine Not connected UNKNOWN ACCESS DOES NOT ESTABLISH A guaranteed travel time to any destination Utility connection availability or capacity at the boundary Legal right of way where none is separately verified Future road-widening or corridor commitments INDICATIVE UNTIL VERIFIED AGAINST A RECORDED RIGHT OF WAY. No travel-time, transit-proximity or utility-availability figure is generated by this module today. LANDINTEL · PROXIMITY CATCHMENT CONFIGURABLE, UNKNOWN CONTENTS Set a radius. Nothing inside it is invented. This radius is a straight-line ("as the crow flies") distance from the resolved site, not a routed travel time. No place, business, school, hospital or transit stop is listed inside it until a licensed POI/routing source is connected — every category below reads UNKNOWN rather than an invented count or name. CURRENT RADIUS 2.00 km (1.24 mi) · straight-line radius Radius (0.5–20 km) Kilometres Miles DISPLAY UNIT Kilometres Miles Schools & education UNKNOWN Count and distance of schools within the radius. Healthcare UNKNOWN Hospitals and clinics within the radius. Public transit UNKNOWN Metro, rail and organized bus stops within the radius. Retail & daily needs UNKNOWN Grocery, pharmacy and daily-needs retail within the radius. Employment nodes UNKNOWN Major office/industrial clusters within the radius. INDICATIVE RADIUS ONLY — NOT A TRAVEL-TIME ANALYSIS. Connecting a licensed POI/routing source is required before any category above can show a real count, name or distance.
